title: Dynamical chiral symmetry breaking in rotating QED$_3$: critical flavor number and the occupation-reweighting channel
summary: We study dynamical chiral symmetry breaking in $(2{+}1)$-dimensional QED on a rigidly rotating disc, $ΩR<1$, within the rainbow Schwinger--Dyson framework. At zero temperature the rotation response of the condensate vanishes identically, so $N_c^{\rm SD}(Ω,T{=}0)=N_c^{\rm SD}(0)=2.60\pm0.01$ (using three operational definitions).
